import sys

def main():
    MOD = 1000000007
    data = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    n = int(data.split()[0])
    mat = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    total = 0
    
    for row in range(n + 1):
        mat[row][0] = 1
        if row & 1:
            total = (total + 1) % MOD
    
    for row in range(1, n + 1):
        for col in range(1, row + 1):
            mat[row][col] = (mat[row][col - 1] + mat[row - 1][col]) % MOD
            if (row + col) & 1:
                total = (total + mat[row][col]) % MOD
    
    print(total)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
